title: Operational Limits and Recovery
description: Progress from an intuitive model to the source implementation and its operational boundary: Operational Limits and Recovery.
learning_objectives: Explain operational limits and recovery using a plain-language model
Trace the source implementation for operational limits and recovery
Assess failure and operational limits of operational limits and recovery
concepts_covered: A successful local put is not an off-site backup; production systems need retention, replication, access controls, key custody, and restore drills.
Restore reads encrypted local chunks; the code has no remote backend, scheduler, retention policy, snapshots, or prune command.
practical_outcomes: Explain at least one operational boundary
completion_criteria: Complete all three lessons and exercise
Score at least 7/10 on the assessment
